title: Morning Star Cottage & Carriage House
meta_description: Welcome to Morning Star, a luxury WaterColor retreat in the peaceful Forest District. Enjoy a private plunge pool courtyard, separate carriage house, plus a golf cart and bikes included for exploring 30A and nearby Seaside.
description_expanded: Description⭐ Why Guests Book Morning Star✔ Private plunge pool (rare in WaterColor)✔ 6-seater golf cart INCLUDED✔ Beach Towels Included✔ Separate carriage house for added flexibility✔ Multiple king suites (high-demand feature)✔ Access to 6 pools + private beach + amenities✔ Ideal for families and group vacationsWelcome to Morning Star, your private retreat in the heart of WaterColor—where laid-back luxury meets effortless 30A living.Tucked away in the peaceful Forest District, this home offers something increasingly rare in WaterColor: your own private plunge pool + golf cart + carriage house, all in one stay. It’s the kind of place guests book quickly—and return to year after year.✨ Your Private Outdoor EscapeAfter a day at the beach or exploring 30A, come home to your gated courtyard with a private plunge pool—perfect for cooling off, unwinding, or letting the kids play while you relax nearby.Optional pool heat ($45/day) for cooler monthsFully private setting surrounded by treesOutdoor seating + grill for easy evenings at home Explore 30A Like a Local (No Car Needed)One of the biggest reasons guests choose this home:6-Seater Golf Cart INCLUDED – effortless trips to the beach, pools, and SeasideComplimentary Bikes – ride the iconic 30A trail under shaded oaksCommunity Trolley Access – stress-free transportation throughout WaterColorEverything you need is right at your fingertips—no parking stress, no planning headaches. Spacious, Thoughtfully Designed for GroupsMorning Star is built for connection and comfort:Open-concept living + dining for gatheringLarge kitchen and island for meals and conversationComfortable living room for evenings togetherEvery space feels relaxed, elevated, and easy to enjoy. Flexible Sleeping + Privacy Everyone AppreciatesThis home is ideal for families, multiple couples, or group trips:Multiple king suites (a top booking priority)Bunk room for kids or teensSeparate carriage house = built-in privacy for guests, grandparents, or couples Full Access to WaterColor’s World-Class AmenitiesYour stay includes access to everything that makes WaterColor one of the most in-demand communities on 30A:6 resort-style pools (including Camp WaterColor)Private beach accessTennis courts + basketball courtScenic trails, parks, and green spacesAll just minutes from your door. Prime Location Without the CrowdsLocated in the quiet, highly desirable Forest District, you get the best of both worlds:Peaceful, low-traffic settingQuick access to Seaside, Grayton Beach, and WaterColor Beach ClubClose to dining, shopping, and events—but away from the noise Your 30A Vacation Starts HereWhether you're biking to the beach at sunrise, spending afternoons poolside, or cruising to dinner in Seaside by golf cart, Morning Star makes every part of your trip easy, elevated, and unforgettable.Book now—homes with this combination of features and location in WaterColor fill quickly.TDT-091292
